question: Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?
sql:
WITH top_5_actors AS (
    SELECT actor_id
    FROM (
        SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) as film_count
        FROM film_actor
        GROUP BY actor_id
        ORDER BY film_count DESC
        LIMIT 5
    )
),
films_with_top_5 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT film_id
    FROM film_actor
    WHERE actor_id IN (SELECT actor_id FROM top_5_actors)
),
customers_who_rented AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) as cnt
    FROM rental r
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    WHERE i.film_id IN (SELECT film_id FROM films_with_top_5)
),
total_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM customer
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(c.cnt * 100.0 / t.cnt, 2) as percentage
FROM customers_who_rented c, total_customers t
